title: Animated Sidebar
subtitle: A collapsible side navigation with groups, badges and sub-menus.

descriptions.resizable: Lets you drag the sidebar's edge to change its width.
descriptions.itemRounded: Corner radius of the items and their highlight.
descriptions.slideHighlight: The active highlight slides to the newly chosen item instead of jumping.
descriptions.activeIndicator: Extra mark on the active item.
descriptions.rollingText: Item labels roll to a second copy on hover.
descriptions.elasticTooltips: Tooltips spring out when the sidebar is collapsed to icons.
descriptions.rollingNumbers: Badge counts roll to the new number and pop.
descriptions.showTeamSwitcher: Shows a team menu at the top of the sidebar.
descriptions.spinToggle: The collapse button spins half a turn on hover.
descriptions.showBreadcrumb: Shows a breadcrumb and search in the page header.
descriptions.scaleContent: Page content scales and fades slightly when you switch pages.

themeDescription: Colour palette, tooltips included. With Highlight color set to Primary, the active item takes its primary colour.
